title: Version harmonization and gradual promote gates for support channels
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We lack a single, machine-actionable model for how runtime, REST API, SDKs and Console are versioned and promoted between support horizons (stability lane / extended support / maintenance). This causes ad-hoc rollouts, missed compatibility checks and customer upgrade friction.

Goal: Define a version harmonization model and a set of automated "promote gates" that make cross-surface upgrades predictable. Produce a support matrix that maps runtime ABI, API surface, SDK semver guarantees, and Console UI expectations per support horizon. Implement preflight validators, canary cohort policy, and rollback hooks to be consumed by release automation.

Deliverables: 1) Support matrix CSV + human-readable spec; 2) Preflight validation tool (CIDR checks for private + schema/IDL compatibility); 3) Promote-gates as GitHub Actions/workflow steps; 4) Canary orchestration recipe for Dedicated and Private fleets; 5) Console rollout plan which includes feature flags and warning banners for deprecated behaviors.
acceptance_criteria: Support matrix published in Confluence and linked in the release checklist
Preflight validator integrated in release pipeline and failing on schema drift
Automated canary promotion/gating workflow merged to release-infra repo
Console shows upgrade warning for incompatible SDK/runtime combinations
Post-deploy SLO checks and automated rollback triggered in at least one staged rollout
rollout_plan: 1) Publish matrix and socialize with SDK/runtime teams (days 0-3). 2) Ship preflight validator as a GH Action (days 4-10). 3) Run dry-run promotions on test clusters and validate canary metrics (days 11-16). 4) First production canary using 1% traffic with automated SLO gating and 15-minute watch window (days 17-20). 5) Gradual promote to 5/25/100 with automated checks and manual approval at 25% for Dedicated customers. 6) For Private installs, provide an upgrade verifier tool and documentation for offline preflight.
risks_mitigation:
Risk: false positives from preflight validator -> Mitigation: allow opt-out via flag for emergency patches and add a --verify-only mode.
Risk: Console/SDK timing mismatch -> Mitigation: pin SDK compatibility metadata to releases and expose a console-level compatibility endpoint.
Risk: Canary failure causing customer impact -> Mitigation: automated quick rollback and immutable canary cohorts to reduce blast radius.
decision_log: 2025-02-11 - Decided to model compatibility at three axes: public REST API contract, runtime binary/ABI boundaries, and SDK behavioral guarantees. (Aisha, Lina, Tomás)
2025-02-14 - Chose GitHub Actions for gate enforcement to avoid adding another orchestration service. (ENG-release-infra sync)
2025-02-18 - Agreed on default canary cadence: 1% for 15 minutes -> auto-evaluate -> 5% for 30 minutes -> 25% manual checkpoint -> 100% auto-promote on green. (Release eng + SRE)
2025-02-19 - Security signoff required for Private upgrade verifier due to KMS/HSM interactions. (Security)
comments: 2025-02-12 - Tomás: Prototype validator that checks OpenAPI drift + protobuf version mismatches is in a feature branch. Initial run caught a broken Console schema in feature/x. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-infra/pull/482
2025-02-13 - Lina (SDK lead): We'll add a compatibility label to SDK releases. SDK pipeline will fail if we detect calls to removed endpoints when compiled against new runtime stubs.
2025-02-15 - PM review from Jorge: Please include customer-facing messaging and upgrade windows for enterprise customers as part of the plan. Added to artifacts and console banner tasks.
2025-02-17 - QA: Ran dry-run promotions across staging clusters; discovered KV cache format change causes a rare failure for sequences > 32k — adding a migration shim and test coverage.
2025-02-19 - SRE: Implemented SLO gate based on P50 latency and error rate; integration test passing in canary harness. Need approval for auto-rollback thresholds.
